summary: This PR widens the live-deployment chunk-crawl regex to also follow bare side-effect imports (`import"./x.js"`), which is the form 24 of the 28 lazy tool chunks use to reach the `_commonjs-dynamic-modules` helper whose 404 caused the TD-033 outage. It also registers three new tech-debt entries (TD-034/035/036) found during the prior review rather than fixing them in a hotfix. The regex change is correct and is a genuine tightening as well as a widening — the added `\b` anchors prevent matches inside identifiers, and I traced the false-positive surface (`"from":"./x.js"` JSON, `from:` object keys) and confirmed the pattern rejects them. Two non-blocking nits only.
